changeSet.author: docflow
changeSet.comment: Create document_parent table with sequence and trigger
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER document_parent_bir BEFORE INSERT ON document_parent FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.id IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT document_parent_seq.NEXTVAL INTO :NEW.id FROM dual; END;

changeSet.sql: MERGE INTO USER_ROLES t USING (SELECT 'approver1' user_id, 'APPROVER' role_name FROM dual) s ON (t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.role_name = s.role_name) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, user_id, role_name, assigned_at) VALUES (user_roles_seq.NEXTVAL, s.user_id, s.role_name, SYSTIMESTAMP);
